page.overview:
Who is O'Shea?

Captain O'Shea was the commander of the Federation starship in 2270.

In 2270, Orion pirates boarded the Huron and injured him and two other officers, rendering them unconscious. They were discovered by a landing party from the . Dr. McCoy performed minor surgery on O'Shea and he later made a full recovery. ()

O'Shea's was one of the character voices provided by James Doohan. He is described in the script as "a craggy-faced man".

O'Shea wore no rank insignia, therefore making it unclear whether he was a captain by rank, or by position only. Confusingly, he referred to his ship as the "SS Huron", implying it to be a civilian vessel, but the vessel's hull was clearly marked "USS Huron".
